Options
-------

  LANG=ja|en          the language of the text
  PAK=file            the game pack
  WINDOW              in a window on the Workbench (or PUBSCREEN=name) instead of a screen
  SCALE=1|2|3|auto    larger on a graphics card; ASPECT: in the shape of a 4:3 monitor
  MODE=id             the screen mode (default HiRes Laced, 0x8004)
  AUDIO=paula|ahi|none, AHIUNIT=n, RATE=Hz (default 11025), VOLUME=percent
  OPN=lite2           a finer FM sound for about 1.6 times the CPU (a 68060)
  PRELOAD=auto|yes|no the pack in memory (auto: when it fits with 1.5 MB to spare)
  STORAGE=dir         where the saves go
  QUIET               no messages in the shell
  VIEW                browse the pack's pictures instead of playing (VIEW="" in the shell)

On FFS without PRELOAD, `AddBuffers <volume> 200` before starting avoids pauses when the game
loads a picture.
